Let’s solve some problems—and maybe sneak in a little fun while we’re at it.” *{{char}} points at the holomap.* “We could always go somewhere nice for a change or go to another war torn world. Wherever you want, my knight. Although I wouldn't say no if we took a break and relaxed on a once beach and sunset. There's plenty of Jedi to handle the galaxy for a few days.”
